page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew lexicon entries, parallel, separated by a vertical rule. Left column first, then right. Running head at top of each column (Hebrew letters). Catchword at lower right, signature at lower left.

main_text.l: תַּתִּם integrum exhibes, Job. 22. 3. pro תַּתִּם fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. תָּמַם.
תֹּתַּם, vel תְּתַּם consume-ris, vel tur, pro תָּתַּם, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. R. תָּמַם.
תִּתְמַה miraberis, vel tur, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. תָּמַהּ.
תִּתְמּוֹגַג dissolvat se ipsam, fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. Rad. מוּג.
תִּתְמוֹגְגֶנָה colliquescent, pro תִּתְמוּגַּגְנָה, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. f. Rad. מוּג.
תִּתְמֶךָּ tenebis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. תָּמַךְ.
תִּתַּמֶּם integrum exhibes te, Psal. 18. 26. pro תִּתְתַּמֵּם, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. תָּמַם.
תִּתַּן dare, 1. Reg. 17. 14. pro תֵּת, Infin. Kal, pro תֵּתָן, cum Nun redund. Rad. נָתַן.
תִּתֵּן dabis, תִּתְּנוּ dabitis, תִּתְּנִי dabis, f. תִּתְּנָהּ dabis eum, תִּתְּנֵנוּ nos, תִּתְּנֶנּוּ eum, תִּתְּנִנִי me, fut. Kal, 2. f. & pl. m. & 2. f. f. ut & 2. f. m. cum aff. Rad. נָתַן.
תִּתְנוֹדֵד commoves te, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. נָדַד, vel נוֹד; & utriusque Piel, est נוֹדֵד.
תִּתְנַחֲלוּ possessionem adibitis, fut. Hithp. 2. pl. m. Rad. נָחַל.
תִּתְנַקָּם ultionem sumeres, vel ret, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. R. נָקַם.
תִּתְנַשָּׂא attolles, vel let se, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָשָׂא.
תִּתְעֶה aberrabis, apoc. pro תִּתְעֶה, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. תָּעָה.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and some forms in the right column are doubtful at this scan resolution; marked [?] where the letters or points are not clearly legible. The Hebrew forms are copied as close to the printed shapes as the image allows and may contain pointing errors. The running heads and catchword are Hebrew letters as printed. Entries are given one line per printed line; the right column's entry on dabis is set over several printed lines.
